title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along downtown, civic, and river-oriented Saint Peter corridors, each paired with one verified reason to stop.

cards.title: See Community Art
cards.subtitle: South Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Minnesota Avenue storefront corridor and check the Arts Center’s schedule before entering for an exhibition or performance.
cards.short_summary: A downtown community arts facility presenting exhibitions, performances, education, and outreach.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arts Center operates at 315 South Minnesota Avenue and supports exhibitions, performances, education, and outreach.
cards.source_title: About | Arts Center of Saint Peter
cards.access_notes: Programs, classes, and gallery availability vary; consult the Arts Center before visiting.

cards.title: Pause for Coffee or Tea
cards.subtitle: South Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this downtown storefront as a daytime pause; review the posted menu and current hours before choosing a drink or plate.
cards.short_summary: A café stop with beverages and food on Saint Peter’s principal downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: River Rock lists its Saint Peter café at 301 South Minnesota Avenue and identifies it as a coffee-and-tea location.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Saturday 6 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm before departure.

cards.title: Browse Kitchen Tools
cards.subtitle: South Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Minnesota Avenue to browse cookware, cutlery, bakeware, and kitchen gadgets during the shop’s posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned kitchen shop suited to a focused downtown browsing stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Cooks & Company operates at 316 South Minnesota Avenue and sells cookware, cutlery, bakeware, and kitchen gadgets.
cards.access_notes: The business posts weekday and Saturday hours and no Sunday hours; verify the schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Ask About a Bike Repair
cards.subtitle: South Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a repair question to this Minnesota Avenue bike shop, but check its limited weekly schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A downtown bicycle shop centered on service, repairs, accessories, and wheel building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smallest Cog is listed at 115 South Minnesota Avenue as a bicycle shop focused on service, repair, accessories, and wheel building.
cards.source_title: The Smallest Cog - St. Peter Chamber
cards.access_notes: The current Chamber listing shows limited Thursday–Saturday hours; confirm directly before bringing a bicycle.

cards.title: Pick Up Groceries
cards.subtitle: West Mulberry Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto Mulberry Street for groceries or prepared food; anyone may shop, so a co-op membership is not required to enter.
cards.short_summary: A community-owned, full-service grocery store with a deli and café-style seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. Peter Food Co-op operates at 228 West Mulberry Street, offers full grocery departments and a deli, and states that anyone can shop there.
cards.source_title: About Us - Values & History | St. Peter Food Co-op
cards.access_notes: The co-op’s official contact page lists daily hours; check it for holiday or temporary changes.

cards.title: Settle In with a Book
cards.subtitle: South Washington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to Washington Avenue for reading or research, and check the library calendar if you want to pair the stop with a program.
cards.short_summary: A public library offering collections, digital resources, events, and space for learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Peter Public Library is located at 601 South Washington Avenue and provides library collections, digital resources, and public programming.
cards.access_notes: The city posts Monday–Saturday library hours; verify holiday closures and card requirements for borrowing.

cards.title: Use the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: South Fifth Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow Fifth Street to the Community Center, bring clean shoes, and use the indoor track outside its posted cleaning closure.
cards.short_summary: A civic recreation facility with a no-charge indoor walking and running track.
cards.evidence_claim: The Community Center at 600 South Fifth Street has a walking and running track available during building hours at no charge.
cards.access_notes: Building hours vary by season; the track closes Tuesdays from 7–10 a.m. for cleaning, and clean shoes are required.

cards.title: Take a Park Break
cards.subtitle: South Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk south along Minnesota Avenue for a park break near the pavilion, playground, courts, and veterans memorial.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding city park combining open recreation facilities with community gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Square Park at 1000 South Minnesota Avenue includes a pavilion, playground, picnic area, basketball court, tennis courts, and veterans memorial.
cards.access_notes: City park hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; facilities or reserved areas may be unavailable during events.

cards.title: Choose a Picnic Table
cards.subtitle: South Washington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Pair a library visit with this nearby Washington Avenue park; choose a table or playground stop while respecting redesign work.
cards.short_summary: A central neighborhood park beside the library and Community Center area.
cards.evidence_claim: The city identifies Gorman Park on South Washington Avenue near the Community Center and library, with picnic tables and playground equipment.
cards.access_notes: The city says the park is in a redesign process; check current conditions before planning around specific amenities.

cards.title: Follow the Interpretive Trail
cards.subtitle: North Minnesota Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue north on Minnesota Avenue and follow the self-guided paths to engage carefully with Dakota history and the 1851 treaty site.
cards.short_summary: A historic landscape with interpretive paths addressing Dakota history and the 1851 treaty negotiations.
cards.evidence_claim: Traverse des Sioux is located at 1851 North Minnesota Avenue and offers paths interpreting Dakota history and the site’s complex historical significance.
cards.source_title: Traverse des Sioux | Minnesota Historical Society
cards.access_notes: The outdoor site has self-guided paths; consult the Minnesota Historical Society page for current site and visitor information.
